fact: The National Police Service's annual report for 2022 states that the Digital Occurrence Book, launched on 21 November 2019 at Kasarani Sub-County in Nairobi County, captures the details of suspects reported to a police station and of the officers assigned in real time, and that in 2022 senior police commanders could access and monitor its use from their offices; it gives no count of stations.
title: National Police Service Annual Report 2022
